reviews.title: Good motherboard at a good price
reviews.comment: A really great motherboard.  Plenty of ports are available. The look of the motherboard is cool too. It fir well in my Lian Li 217 case.
reviews.author: mrnexs

reviews.title: Dead on Arrival
reviews.comment: Unfortunately, I got everything installed ad went to boot it up and consistently got a dram error light. It wouldnt even boot to bios. I tried udating the bios using the flash button and a usb and I could see the lights blinking so i thought it would update and potentially fix the issue but it did not. I had to return the product. Purchased a different mobo from a different manufacturer and everything booted right up when connected. Would not recommend this product.
reviews.author: PatrickP

reviews.title: Good with Ubuntu
reviews.comment: No RGB light control for Linux, but otherwise everything else works well on Linux (Ubuntu 24) despite Gigabyte not officially supporting Linux. Speeds are good for AMD5 processors. Ethernet port and wifi work well.
reviews.author: Alice

reviews.title: Mother board
reviews.comment: Good cheap and works great, this item shipped fast.

reviews.title: Great Mobo
reviews.comment: Great Mobo! Has all the functions and I/O I needed when I built my PC, all the basics, no crazy bells and whistles. Make sure this board has all the connectors you need before you purchase it!
reviews.author: BrentY
